original.statement: A bug fix in the Argo CD UI allows applications to be added when both name and server destination are specified, whereas this was previously unsupported.

decision.reason: [ev-5cbf04b8633d] only says a UI bug was fixed: the UI could not add an app that had both a name and a server destination. That is a front-end form fix, not wire or protocol behaviour, so the protocol-behavior subject is a forced fit. The evidence names no config key, CRD field, API endpoint or other typed subject that changed, so no correct typed assertion follows from it.
